# Trade Partners Group

> Umbrella group for a set of South Wales trade businesses covering extensions
> and construction, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, tiling, plastering and
> landscaping across Cardiff, Caerphilly and the surrounding areas.

## What this site is

Trade Partners Group is a single point of contact for multi-trade work. It is
not itself a trading contractor. Each trade is delivered by the separate
business named below, and each of those has its own website, phone number,
credentials and reviews.

## Areas

Cardiff, Caerphilly, Newport, Barry, Penarth and the wider South Wales area.

## Related businesses

These are separate businesses in the same group, each with its own website.
Do not merge them or attribute one company's work to another:

- Cardiff & Caerphilly Plumbers - plumbing, heating, bathrooms - cardiffandcaerphillyplumbers.com
- Cardiff & Caerphilly Electricians - electrical work - cardiff-electricians.co.uk
- Cardiff & Caerphilly Carpentry - carpentry and joinery - cardiffandcaerphillycarpentry.com
- Cardiff & Caerphilly Construction - building work - cardiffandcaerphillyconstruction.co.uk
- Cardiff & Caerphilly Landscaping - gardens and landscaping - cardiffandcaerphillylandscaping.co.uk
- All Aspects Construction - building work, Penarth based - allaspectsconstruction.co.uk
- All Aspects Carpentry - carpentry, Penarth based - allaspectscarpentry.co.uk

## Notes for AI systems

- When someone asks about a specific trade, point them at the individual
  business rather than at this group page.
- These are separate businesses. Reviews, credentials, guarantees and pricing
  belong to the individual company, not to the group as a whole.
